WORLD.description: set world to use (set 'old' for using the old world). if no world exists a new one will be set automatically

CONCURRENT_SIMULATION.description: How many simulation groups may be in the universe simultaniously (performance)

SECTOR_SIZE.description: Sets the size of sectors in the universe **WARNING** scaling the size of an existing universe down may cause issues

BLUEPRINT_DEFAULT_PRIVATE.description: If true, set blueprints private as default (else they are public)

BLUEPRINT_UPLOAD_SPEED.description: The speed at which clients can upload blueprints to the server. Specifically, this setting affects the upload block size, which is essentially how big each package sent from the client can be.

FLOATING_ITEM_LIFETIME_SECS.description: How much seconds items floating in space should be alive

SIMULATION_SPAWN_DELAY.description: How much seconds between simulation spawn ticks

SIMULATION_TRADING_FILLS_SHOPS.description: Trading guild will deliver stock to shops

SECTOR_INACTIVE_TIMEOUT.description: Time in secs after which sectors go inactive (-1 = off)

SECTOR_INACTIVE_CLEANUP_TIMEOUT.description: Time in secs after which inactive sectors are completely removed from memory (-1 = off)

REQUIRE_STARMADE_AUTHENTICATION.description: require star-made.org authentication (USE_STARMADE_AUTHENTICATION must be true)

PROTECTED_NAMES_BY_ACCOUNT.description: How many player names a player may protect with his account (if exceeded, the player name, that was logged in the longest time ago gets unprotected)

DEFAULT_BLUEPRINT_ENEMY_USE.description: Default option for blueprints not in catalog yet

DEFAULT_BLUEPRINT_FACTION_BUY.description: Default option for blueprints not in catalog yet

DEFAULT_BLUEPRINT_OTHERS_BUY.description: Default option for blueprints not in catalog yet

DEFAULT_BLUEPRINT_HOME_BASE_BUY.description: Default option for blueprints not in catalog yet

LOCK_FACTION_SHIPS.description: If true, ships of other factions cant be edited, activated, or entered

CATALOG_SLOTS_PER_PLAYER.description: How many slots per player for saved ships (-1 for unlimited)

UNIVERSE_DAY_IN_MS.description: how long is a 'day' (stellar system rotation) in milliseconds (-1 to switch off system rotation)

ASTEROIDS_ENABLE_DYNAMIC_PHYSICS.description: enables asteroids to be able to move in space

ENABLE_BREAK_OFF.description: debug (don't activate unless you know what you're doing)

COLLISION_DAMAGE.description: colliding into another object does damage

COLLISION_DAMAGE_THRESHOLD.description: Threshold of Impulse that does damage (the lower, the less force is needed for damage)

SKIN_ALLOW_UPLOAD.description: if off, skin uploading to server is deactivated

CATALOG_NAME_COLLISION_HANDLING.description: if off, saving with an existing entry is denied, if on the name is automatically changed by adding numbers on the end

SECTOR_AUTOSAVE_SEC.description: Time interval in secs the server will autosave (-1 for never)

PHYSICS_SLOWDOWN_THRESHOLD.description: Milliseconds a collision test may take before anti-slowdown mode is activated

THRUST_SPEED_LIMIT.description: How fast ships, etc. may go in m/s . Too high values may induce physics tunneling effects

MAX_CLIENTS.description: Max number of clients allowed on this server

SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD_USE.description: Enable super admin for this server

SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Super admin password for this server

SERVER_LISTEN_IP.description: Enter specific ip for the server to listen to. use "all" to listen on every ip

SOCKET_BUFFER_SIZE.description: buffer size of incoming and outgoing data per socket

PHYSICS_LINEAR_DAMPING.description: how much object slow down naturally (must be between 0 and 1): 0 is no slowdown

PHYSICS_ROTATIONAL_DAMPING.description: how much object slow down naturally (must be between 0 and 1): 0 is no slowdown

AI_DESTRUCTION_LOOT_COUNT_MULTIPLIER.description: multiply amount of items in a loot stack. use values smaller 1 for less and 0 for none

AI_DESTRUCTION_LOOT_STACK_MULTIPLIER.description: multiply amount of items spawned after AI destruction. use values smaller 1 for less and 0 for none

CHEST_LOOT_COUNT_MULTIPLIER.description: multiply amount of items in a loot stack. use values smaller 1 for less and 0 for none

CHEST_LOOT_STACK_MULTIPLIER.description: multiply amount of items spawned in chests of generated chests. use values smaller 1 for less and 0 for none

USE_WHITELIST.description: only names/ips from whitelist.txt are allowed

USE_UDP.description: Use 'User Datagram Protocol' (UDP) instead of 'Transmission Control Protocol' (TCP) for connections

AUTO_KICK_MODIFIED_BLUEPRINT_USE.description: Kick players that spawn modified blueprints

AUTO_BAN_ID_MODIFIED_BLUEPRINT_USE.description: Ban player by name that spawn modified blueprints

AUTO_BAN_IP_MODIFIED_BLUEPRINT_USE.description: Ban player by IP that spawn modified blueprints

AUTO_BAN_TIME_IN_MINUTES.description: Time to ban in minutes (-1 for permanently)

TCP_NODELAY.description: Naggles algorithm (WARNING: only change when you know what you're doing)

PING_FLUSH.description: flushes ping/pong immediately (WARNING: only change when you know what you're doing)

SHOP_SPAWNING_PROBABILITY.description: (must be between 0 and 1): 0 is no shops spawned in asteroid sectors, 1 is shop spawned in everyone (default: 8% -> 0.08)

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_X_1.description: First Rotating Spawn: Local Pos X Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_Y_1.description: First Rotating Spawn: Local Pos Y Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_Z_1.description: First Rotating Spawn: Local Pos Z Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_X_2.description: Second Rotating Spawn: Local Pos X Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_Y_2.description: Second Rotating Spawn: Local Pos Y Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_Z_2.description: Second Rotating Spawn: Local Pos Z Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_X_3.description: Third Rotating Spawn: Local Pos X Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_Y_3.description: Third Rotating Spawn: Local Pos Y Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_Z_3.description: Third Rotating Spawn: Local Pos Z Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_X_4.description: Forth Rotating Spawn: Local Pos X Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_Y_4.description: Forth Rotating Spawn: Local Pos Y Coordinate

DEFAULT_SPAWN_POINT_Z_4.description: Forth Rotating Spawn: Local Pos Z Coordinate

PLAYER_DEATH_CREDIT_PUNISHMENT.description: players credits lost of total on death (must be between 0 and 1): 1 = lose all, 0 = keep all

PLAYER_DEATH_CREDIT_DROP.description: drop credits lost on death into space instead

PLAYER_DEATH_BLOCK_PUNISHMENT.description: player will drop all his blocks into space on death

PLAYER_DEATH_PUNISHMENT_TIME.description: Time interval in seconds after death of a player in which the player is not punished

ALLOW_CHAT_COLOR_CODES.description: If true, all players can use color codes in chat messages (e.g &bl for blue text).

ALLOW_CHAT_ASCII_EXTRA.description: If true, all players can use extended ASCII characters in chat messages (e.g. Ü, ñ, é, etc.).

DISPLAY_MODULE_CHAR_LIMIT.description: how many characters a display module may have (default: 2000)

DISPLAY_MODULE_LINE_LIMIT.description: how many lines a display module may have (default: 20)

PLAYER_HISTORY_BACKLOG.description: How many login history objects (with name, IP, account-name, and time) should be saved by player state

PROJECTILES_ADDITIVE_VELOCITY.description: initial projectile speed depend on relative linear velocity of object fired from

WEAPON_RANGE_REFERENCE.description: Reference distance for weapon ranges. (what blockBehaviorConfig.xml weapon ranges are multiplied with (usually the sector size)). Set to 1 to interpret weapon ranges in the config in meters

ALLOW_UPLOAD_FROM_LOCAL_BLUEPRINTS.description: enables clients being able to upload their pre-build-blueprints to the server

SHOP_NPC_STARTING_CREDITS.description: how much credits do shops start with

SHOP_NPC_RECHARGE_CREDITS.description: how much credits do shops gain about every 10 min

AI_WEAPON_AIMING_ACCURACY.description: how accurate the AI aims (the higher the value the more accurate vs distance. 10 = about 99% accuracy at 10m)

BROADCAST_SHIELD_PERCENTAGE.description: percent of shields changed for the server to broadcast a shield synch

BROADCAST_POWER_PERCENTAGE.description: percent of power changed for the server to broadcast a power synch (not that critical)

ADMINS_CIRCUMVENT_STRUCTURE_CONTROL.description: admins can enter ships of any faction

SQL_NIO_FILE_SIZE.description: megabyte limit of .data file when to use NIO (faster) (must be power of 2)

PLANET_CORES_INVULNERABLE.description: if true, all planets cores are invulnerable

PLANET_SIZE_DEVIATION_VALUE.description: Planet size standard deviation. Note: normal gaussian distribution graph scaled horizontally by 1/3 (min 0)

ASTEROID_RADIUS_MAX.description: Asteroid max radius in blocks (from -x to +x)

ASTEROID_RESOURCE_SIZE.description: Average diameter of resource veins in asteroids

ASTEROID_RESOURCE_CHANCE.description: Chance per block to place a new resource vein (1.0 = 100%)

PLAYER_MAX_BUILD_AREA.description: max area a player may add/remove in adv. build mode

MAX_MULTI_PLACE_DRAG_INSTANCES.description: max number of instances that can be placed in one multi-place drag session

ASTEROID_SECTOR_REPLENISH_TIME_SEC.description: seconds until a sector that is mined down to 0 asteroids is replenished (-1 = never)

NT_SPAM_PROTECT_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: max attempts before refusing connections in spam protect period (default is 1/sec for 30 sec)

NT_SPAM_PROTECT_EXCEPTIONS.description: ips excepted from spam control (separate multiple with comma) (default is localhost)

ANNOUNCE_SERVER_TO_SERVERLIST.description: announces the server to the starmade server list so clients can find it. Hostname must be provided for HOST_NAME_TO_ANNOUNCE_TO_SERVER_LIST!

HOST_NAME_TO_ANNOUNCE_TO_SERVER_LIST.description: this must be a valid hostname (either ip or host, e.g. play.star-made.org)

MISSILE_DEFENSE_FRIENDLY_FIRE.description: can shoot down own or missiles from own faction

USE_DYNAMIC_RECIPE_PRICES.description: use recipe based prices (the price is the price of the parts it is made out of in crafting)

MAKE_HOMBASE_ATTACKABLE_ON_FP_DEFICIT.description: Home bases become attackable if a faction's Faction Points are in the minus and the faction doesn't own any territory

PLANET_SPECIAL_REGION_PROBABILITY.description: one out of thisValue chance of a special region spawning per planet plate (cities, pyramids, etc) (changing this value migth change some plates, but won't change any plates that are already modified by a player)

NT_BLOCK_QUEUE_SIZE.description: How many blocks are sent per update. Huge placements will shot faster, but it will consume more bandwidth and is subject to spamming players

CHUNK_REQUEST_THREAD_POOL_SIZE_TOTAL.description: Thead pool size for chunk requests (from disk and generated)

CHUNK_REQUEST_THREAD_POOL_SIZE_CPU.description: Available threads of total for CPU generation. WARNING: too high can cause cpu spikes. About the amount of available cores minus one is best

SHOP_USE_STATIC_SELL_BUY_PRICES.description: shop buy and sell price change depending on stock (shop prices will always stay the same if true)

SHOP_SELL_BUY_PRICES_UPPER_LIMIT.description: maximum of base price a shop will want depending on its stock (e.g. max 120 credits if the normal cost is 100)

SHOP_SELL_BUY_PRICES_LOWER_LIMIT.description: minimum of base price a shop will want depending on its stock (e.g. max 80 credits if the normal cost is 100)

MAX_LOGIC_ACTIVATIONS_AT_ONCE_PER_OBJECT.description: warn about objects that activate more than x blocks at once
stop logic of objects that activate more than x blocks at once. They will enter a logic cooldown of 10 seconds to prevent servers from overloading

ALLOWED_STATIONS_PER_SECTOR.description: How many stations are allowed per sector

STATION_CREDIT_COST.description: how much does a station or station blueprint cost

SKIN_SERVER_UPLOAD_BLOCK_SIZE.description: how fast should skins be transferred from server to clients (too high might cause lag) [default 256 ~ 16kb/s]

WEIGHTED_CENTER_OF_MASS.description: if on, the center of mass for each structured will be calculated based on block mass. On 'false', the center of mass is always the core position

SECURE_UPLINK_ENABLED.description: dedicated servers can be registered on the StarMade registry

SECURE_UPLINK_TOKEN.description: uplink token, provided when registering a dedicated server

USE_STRUCTURE_HP.description: ships and other structures use the hitpoint system. if off, a ship will overheat when the core gets taken out (old)

SHOP_REBOOT_COST_PER_SECOND.description: Cost to reboot a ship at a shop (per second it would take to reboot in space)

SHOP_ARMOR_REPAIR_COST_PER_HITPOINT.description: Cost to repair a ship's armor at a shop

MAX_SIMULTANEOUS_EXPLOSIONS.description: the more the faster explosions at the same time are executed (costs in total about 20MB RAM each and of course CPU because it's all threaded) (10 is default for a medium powered singleplayer)

ACID_MAX_BLOCK_OPS_PER_UPDATE.description: Maximum acid block damage/propagation steps processed per entity per acid update tick. Lower this if acid weapons cause server lag or combat ping spikes (2048 is the historical default; 256 is the gentler pre-rework value).

ACID_UPDATE_FREQUENCY_MS.description: Minimum milliseconds between propagation steps for a single acid instance. Higher values slow acid spread and reduce server load (10 is the historical default; 90 is the gentler pre-rework value).

ELEMENT_COLLECTION_RECALC_DEBOUNCE_MS.description: Minimum milliseconds between full recalculations of an entity's block systems (thrusters, weapons, reactor, etc.) while it keeps changing. Higher coalesces the recalc / mesh-rebuild / reactor convex-hull storm during heavy block destruction (acid, explosions), at the cost of briefly stale system stats. 0 = recalc as fast as possible (legacy behavior).

PROJECTILE_RAYCAST_AABB_CACHE.description: Enables the per-tick broadphase AABB cache used by weapon raycasts in busy sectors (>32 collision objects). Leave ON for performance. Set OFF only as a diagnostic.

PROJECTILE_MAX_COLLISION_STEP.description: Maximum distance a projectile may travel per collision check. When a single frame would move it further (fast weapons at low server FPS), the movement is split into multiple collision-checked sub-steps so it cannot tunnel through a target without registering a hit. 0 = disabled (one check per frame, legacy behavior).

EXPLOSION_APPLY_BUDGET_MS.description: Maximum milliseconds per server tick spent applying finished explosions' block damage to entities. A fleet-fight volley can finish many explosions at once; without a budget, applying them all in one tick froze the server main loop for hundreds of ms. Excess explosions are applied on following ticks (at least one is always applied per tick). 0 = unlimited (legacy behavior).

REPULSE_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS.description: Minimum milliseconds between physics sweeps for an ACTIVE repulsor (one that has thrust dedicated to it). Each repulsor block runs a physics sweep over nearby objects; doing it every tick across a fleet is expensive. Higher values trade hover responsiveness for performance. Decorative/unpowered repulsors are skipped entirely regardless of this setting. 0 = every tick (legacy behavior, smoothest hover).

REMOVE_ENTITIES_WITH_INCONSISTENT_BLOCKS.description: This will remove ships that have blocks that are normally disallowed (e.g. space station blocks on ships)

OVERRIDE_INVALID_BLUEPRINT_TYPE.description: If a loaded blueprint is invalid, it's type will be overridden

FACTION_FOUNDER_KICKABLE_AFTER_DAYS_INAC.description: Days of inactivity after which a founder may kick another founder

BLUEPRINT_SPAWNABLE_SHIPS.description: enables or disables blueprint spawning from item

BLUEPRINT_SPAWNABLE_STATIONS.description: enables or disables blueprint spawning from item

USE_OLD_GENERATED_PIRATE_STATIONS.description: enables spawning of old style pirate stations

CARGO_BLEED_AT_OVER_CAPACITY.description: cargo is ejected every minute if storage is at over capacity

ALLOW_PERSONAL_INVENTORY_OVER_CAPACITY.description: Personal Inventory can go over capacity

ONLY_ALLOW_FACTION_SHIPS_ADDED_TO_FLEET.description: only allows faction ships to be added to fleet

MAX_CHAIN_DOCKING.description: maximal deepness of docking chains (may cause glitches depending on OS (path and filename length) at high numbers)

DELETE_DOCKED_ON_OVERHEAT.description: If enabled, all entities docked to an entity (recursively) are deleted along with it when its core fully overheats and the entity is destroyed, instead of being undocked. Helps prevent entity clogging.

SHOP_RAILS_ON_ADV.description: Advanced shops will have 4 rails dockers that can be used like a neutral homebase (anything docked is safe)

SHOP_RAILS_ON_NORMAL.description: Normal shops will have 4 rails dockers that can be used like a neutral homebase (anything docked is safe)

BACKUP_WORLD_ON_MIGRATION.description: Back up world when migrating to a new file format

BACKUP_BLUEPRINTS_ON_MIGRATION.description: Back up blueprints when migrating to a new file format

SECTORS_TO_EXPLORE_FOR_SYS.description: How many sectors of a system have to be explored

NPC_FACTION_SPAWN_LIMIT.description: Maximum npc factions per galaxy (-1 for unlimited (will still be around 2-10))

NPC_DEBUG_MODE.description: Sends complete NPC faction package to clients (very bandwith intensive)

FLEET_OUT_OF_SECTOR_MOVEMENT.description: How long for an unloaded fleet to cross a sector in ms

NPC_LOADED_SHIP_MAX_SPEED_MULT.description: How fast NPC fleet ships are compared to their max speed when loaded

USE_FOW.description: Use 'fog of war'. Turning this off will make everything visible to everyone

NPC_PREVENT_HOMEBASE_SYSTEM_LOSS.description: Prevents NPC factions from losing their homebase system

NPC_SYSTEM_RATIO_LOSS.description: Ratio of asset loss required for an NPC faction to lose control of a system.

USE_PLAYER_FLEET_DELIVERY.description: If enabled, trade deliveries between players can be done by player-assigned fleets instead of NPC fleets.

DEFAULT_GAME_MODE.description: Game mode new players start in. SURVIVAL: normal play. CREATIVE: players are granted creative mode on join (good for creative build servers).

BLUEPRINT_NO_RESOURCE_COST.description: If enabled, spawning/buying blueprints costs no resources or credits (good for creative build servers).

DEBUG_FSM_STATE.description: transfer debug FSM state. Turning this on may slow down network

PHYSICS_SHAPE_CASTING_TUNNELING_PREVENTI.description: Makes a convex cast for hight speed object to prevent clipping. High Cost. (Bugged right now, so dont turn it on)

FORCE_DISK_WRITE_COMPLETION.description: forces writing operations of raw data to disk directly after operation. For some OS this prevents raw data corruption

DEBUG_SEGMENT_WRITING.description: Debugs correctness of writing of segments (costs server performance)

TURNING_DIMENSION_SCALE.description: Scaling of tuning speed VS ship dimension (default = 1.1)

RECIPE_BLOCK_COST.description: How much blocks have to be invested to create a recipe (min 0)

RECIPE_REFUND_MULT.description: how much blocks are refunded from selling a recipe (must be between 0 and 1): 0 no refund, 1 full refund

RECIPE_LEVEL_AMOUNT.description: On how much created blocks will a recipe level up (base value) (min 0)

NT_SPAM_PROTECT_ACTIVE.description: enables connection spawn protection (flooding servers with login attempts)

USE_PERSONAL_SECTORS.description: will spawn a player in a locked sector sandbox (warning, don't use unless you know what you do)

BATTLE_MODE.description: turn on battlemode (warning, don't use unless you know what you're doing)

LEADERBOARD_BACKLOG.description: time in hours to keep leaderboard backlog (the more time, the more data has to be sent to client)

DEBUG_BEAM_POWER_CONSUMPTION.description: server will send notifications on power consumed (not counting power given from supply) on server (costs performance, so only use for debugging)

DEBUG_BEAM_TICKS_DONE.description: server will send notifications on ticks done on server (costs performance, so only use for debugging)

DEBUG_BEAM_POWER_PER_TICK.description: server will send notifications on beam power per tick on server (costs performance, so only use for debugging)

DEBUG_MISSILE_POWER_CONSUMPTION.description: server will send notifications on missiles on server (costs performance, so only use for debugging)

NPC_LOG_MODE.description: use 0 for npc file logs [/logs/npc/] and 1 for normal log output

NPC_DEBUG_SHOP_OWNERS.description: Additional shop owners for npc faction shops (case insensitive, seperate with comma)

SQL_PERMISSION.description: user name allowed to sql query remotely (direct console always allowed /sql_query, /sql_update, /sql_insert_return_generated_keys) (case insensitive, seperate with comma)

ALLOWED_UNPACKED_FILE_UPLOAD_IN_MB.description: how much mb is an uploaded blueprint/skin allowed to have (unzipped)

RESTRICT_BUILDING_SIZE.description: Restricts Building Size to X times Sector Size (-1 for off) Warning: values set in GameConfig.xml overwrite this

MANAGER_CALC_CANCEL_ON.description: Enables performance increase by prematurely ending calculations when there is a refresh request

ALLOW_OLD_POWER_SYSTEM.description: enables old power system (WARNING: once the old power system has been disallowed, it cannot be allowed again and the game will ignore this option, as that would cause compatibility issues.)

JUMP_DRIVE_ENABLED_BY_DEFAULT.description: Weather all ships have jump capability or the basic jump chamber is required for jump capability

SHORT_RANGE_SCAN_DRIVE_ENABLED_BY_DEFAUL.description: Weather all ships have scanner capability or the basic scan chamber is required for scan capability

SPAWN_PROTECTION.description: Spawn protection in seconds (may not yet protect against everything)

AI_ENGAGEMENT_RANGE_OF_MIN_WEAPON_RANGE.description: Percentage of minimum weapon range the AI prefers to engage from

MISSILE_TARGET_PREDICTION_SEC.description: Since lockstep algorithm is based on recorded target positions, how much should a target chasing missiles predict a target's position based on its velocity (in ticks of 8ms). Change if missiles miss fast targets

AI_WEAPON_SWITCH_DELAY.description: Delay inbetween an AI can switch weapon in ms

SHIPYARD_IGNORE_STRUCTURE.description: Removes necessity to build shipyard structure (just computer and ancor is enough)

MISSILE_RADIUS_HP_BASE.description: Missile Damage to Radius relation: MissileRadius = ((3/4π) * (MissileTotalDamage/MISSILE_RADIUS_HP_BASE)) ^ (1/3)

MAX_EXPLOSION_POOL.description: Maximum amount of explosions to keep in pool (to reuse in memory, -1 for unlimited)

SERVER_TICK_PROFILER.description: Times the server main loop and logs the dominant phase when a tick exceeds SERVER_TICK_WARN_MS (very low cost, helps diagnose stalls)

SERVER_TICK_WARN_MS.description: Server main-loop tick budget in ms; ticks slower than this get a per-phase breakdown logged (requires SERVER_TICK_PROFILER)
